description: Story ideas organized by reading level for the book creation wizard

A0.title: Look!
A0.concept: A wordless or near-wordless book showing a child discovering things around them. Each page reveals something new to look at.

A0.title: Big and Small
A0.concept: Visual comparison book - big ball, small ball. Big dog, small dog. Pictures carry all meaning.

A1.title: I Am
A1.concept: Simple labels: 'I am Sam.' One word per page with supporting illustration.

A1.title: A Cat
A1.concept: Labels only: 'A cat.' 'A mat.' 'A sat.' One decodable word per page.

A2.title: I See the ___
A2.concept: Repetitive frame: 'I see the cat.' 'I see the mat.' Only one word changes each page.

A2.title: The ___ Sat
A2.concept: Pattern book: 'The cat sat.' 'The mat sat.' Same sentence frame, changing subject.

A3.title: The Cat Is Here
A3.concept: Simple declaratives with slight variation. 'The cat is here. The cat is on it. The cat ran.'

A3.title: Here and There
A3.concept: Location-based story. Character moves to different spots. 'Sam is here. Sam is there.'

A4.title: Sam and the Hat
A4.concept: Bridge to phonics. Simple narrative: Sam finds a hat, tries it on, something happens, resolution.

A4.title: The Lost Ball
A4.concept: Character wants something, searches, finds it. Simple problem-solution narrative.

B1.title: The Big Pig
B1.concept: Action narrative with CVC short a/i words: A big pig sat. The pig ran. The pig hit the pan!

B1.title: Sam and the Cat
B1.concept: Two characters interact using -at, -an, -it word families. Sam and a cat have an adventure.

B1.title: Pip Gets a Hit
B1.concept: Sports story using short a/i words. Pip tries to hit the ball, misses, finally succeeds!

B2.title: Pup in the Mud
B2.concept: Character wants something, gets it. Pup sees mud, jumps in, has fun, gets a bath. Emotional range: fun, messy!

B2.title: The Red Hen
B2.concept: Classic tale adapted: A hen wants help, no one helps, she does it herself. Uses short o/u/e words.

B2.title: Frog Gets Fun
B2.concept: Frog is bored, tries different things, discovers something fun. Uses all five short vowels.

B3.title: Jump at Camp
B3.concept: Action story with final blends: jump, bump, stomp! Characters at camp have active adventures.

B3.title: Rex and the Runaway Ball
B3.concept: Suspense story: 'What was that?' Ball rolls away, Rex must find it. Uses -nd, -mp, -st blends.

B3.title: The Best Nest
B3.concept: Bird wants to build the best nest. Collects soft, just-right things. FLOSS rule words (off, bell, miss).

B4.title: Frog and Crab
B4.concept: Two characters interact using initial blends. They swim, skip, trip, grab. Friendship story.

B4.title: Flicker the Firefly
B4.concept: A firefly learns to use their light. Uses l-blends, r-blends, s-blends throughout.

B4.title: The Sled Run
B4.concept: Winter adventure with blends: sled, slip, stop, spin. Characters race down a snowy hill.

B5.title: The Ship in the Shell
B5.concept: Discovery story with digraphs: A character finds something special (sh, ch, th, wh words).

B5.title: Zip the Little Snail
B5.concept: A slow snail wishes to be fast. Uses digraphs and -ng endings. 'I wish I could dash!'

B5.title: The Shell Switch
B5.concept: Dialogue-driven: 'She said, What is that?' Hermit crab needs a new shell. Questions in narrative.

B6.title: Kate and the Lake
B6.concept: Character names with silent e (Kate, Jake, Mike). Kate visits a lake, makes a cake, has an adventure.

B6.title: Bake Day
B6.concept: CVCe throughout: make, bake, cake, home, stone. Characters prepare for a celebration.

B6.title: The Bike Ride
B6.concept: Adventure with i_e words: bike, ride, hide, side. Character explores and discovers.

B7.title: A Star at the Farm
B7.concept: Weather and seasons theme. 'The rain came. We had to stay. Then the sun came out to play.'

B7.title: The Rain and the Snow
B7.concept: Weather changes story using vowel teams: rain, snow, day, play, green, dream.

B7.title: Sail Away
B7.concept: Ocean adventure with ai/ay/oa/ow teams. A boat sails to find something special.

B8.title: The Day the Rain Came
B8.concept: Animals (owl, cow, mouse) in outdoor setting. 'The boy found a coin by the brook.'

B8.title: The Owl and the Mouse
B8.concept: Unlikely friendship using oi/oy/ou/ow diphthongs. Night in the forest.

B8.title: The Cloud House
B8.concept: Imagination story with oo words (moon, room, book, look). A character dreams big.

B9.title: A Star at the Farm
B9.concept: Farm/nature adventure. 'After the storm, the girl went to the barn to find her horse.'

B9.title: The Owl and the Boy
B9.concept: Multiple scenes with r-controlled vowels: car, barn, for, her, bird, turn. Night adventure.

B9.title: Purple Turtle's Thursday
B9.concept: Day-in-the-life story using all r-controlled patterns: ar, or, er, ir, ur.

C1.title: The Knight's Quest
C1.concept: Knights, castles, mysteries. 'The knight knew he had to write a sign.' Silent letters throughout.

C1.title: The Night Writer
C1.concept: Mystery story with kn-, wr-, -mb, -gh words. A character solves a puzzle.

C2.title: The Magic City
C2.concept: Cities, stages, magic. 'The giant stood on the bridge near the village.' Soft c/g words.

C2.title: The Giant's Garden
C2.concept: A gentle giant shares their garden. Uses soft c (city, face) and soft g (giant, magic, page).

C3.title: The Kitten in the Basket
C3.concept: Chapter-style story. 'The kitten was hidden in the basket. It happened so suddenly!'

C3.title: The Hidden Mitten
C3.concept: Search story with VC/CV words: hidden, kitten, butter, ladder, suddenly.

C4.title: The Robot and the Pilot
C4.concept: Robots, pilots, adventures. 'The purple turtle hid under the table.'

C4.title: The Paper Airplane
C4.concept: V/CV open syllables and compound words: paper, tiger, robot, sunshine, airplane.

C5.title: The Treehouse Mystery
C5.concept: Natural dialogue. 'I can't find it anywhere! Where'd it go?' Contractions throughout.

C5.title: Everyone's Something
C5.concept: Each character has a special talent. Uses contractions and compound words throughout.

C6.title: The Biggest Race
C6.concept: Past tense narrative. 'She wanted the biggest cookie. She jumped and grabbed it!'

C6.title: The Day Everything Changed
C6.concept: Story with -ed (3 sounds), -ing, -er, -est. Character grows/changes through experience.

C7.title: The Hopeless Garden
C7.concept: Character emotions and motivations. 'She felt hopeless at first, but suddenly found the solution.'

C7.title: The Peaceful Kingdom
C7.concept: Uses -ful, -less, -ness, -ment, -ly suffixes. A kingdom learns about cooperation.

C8.title: The Impossible Invention
C8.concept: Problem-solving, overcoming. 'She had to redo the impossible task. But she didn't give up.'

C8.title: The Unfair Race
C8.concept: Prefixes un-, re-, pre-, dis-, mis-. Character faces unfairness but finds solution.

D1.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
D1.concept: Character-driven with rich dialogue. Multiple speakers distinguished by voice.

D1.title: The Unexpected Visitor
D1.concept: Complex dialogue with varied tags: asked, replied, whispered, shouted. Compound-complex sentences.

D2.title: The Hidden Garden
D2.concept: Show don't tell. 'Her hands trembled as she reached for the handle.' (inference: nervous)

D2.title: The Secret Society
D2.concept: Chapter book with cliffhangers. Character motivation, cause and effect chains, theme identification.

D3.title: The Architect's Secret
D3.concept: Historical, construction, discovery themes. 'The architect inspected the ancient structure.'

D3.title: The Transport Mystery
D3.concept: Latin roots: struct, port, dict, ject, rupt. Character solves a mystery involving old technology.

D4.title: Signals from Kepler
D4.concept: Science fiction, exploration, biography. 'The biologist used her microscope to study the organism.'

D4.title: The Photographer's Journey
D4.concept: Greek roots: graph, phon, photo, bio, geo. Character documents a scientific discovery.

D5.title: The Winter of Words
D5.concept: Literary fiction. 'The old house groaned in protest as the storm raged outside.'

D5.title: The Storm Singer
D5.concept: Figurative language: simile, metaphor, personification. Character with special gift.

D6.title: The Bridge Between
D6.concept: Full literary complexity. Open endings possible. Themes reward reflection. Coming of age.

D6.title: The Last Summer
D6.concept: Multiple perspectives, ambiguity and nuance, author's craft awareness.
